description: This is a Java source file defining the RouteService class in a Spring Boot application. It provides functionality to fetch an optimized driving route between two points using the OpenRouteService API, including constructing HTTP requests, handling JSON responses, and returning route information.

classes.name: RouteService
classes.description: A Spring service class responsible for interacting with the OpenRouteService API to get optimized route data.

methods.name: getOptimizedRoute
methods.description: Fetches an optimized driving route from the external API based on start and end coordinates provided in the RouteRequest, and returns a RouteResponse containing distance, duration, and geometry.
